This is something I modified from /r/Canada:

.side h6 {
 position: relative;
 margin: 0 0 10px 0;
 padding: 5px;
 background: #4aabe7;
 border: 1px solid gray;
 color:white;
 font-family:"monospace","Segoe UI";
 font-weight: bold;
 font-size:120%!important;
 cursor: pointer;
 }

.side h6:after { 
 content: "hover to expand";
 position: absolute;
 top: 5px;
 right: 5px;
 font-size: 9px;
 font-weight: normal;
 color: lightgray;
 }

.side h6 + ul { 
 position: relative;
 margin: -40px 0 10px;
 padding: 28px 0 0;
 list-style: none;
 display: none;
 }

.side h6:hover + ul, .side h6 + ul:hover { 
 display: block;
 }

.side h6 + ul li {
 position: relative;
 padding: 5px;
 border-top: 1px solid #DDD;
 font-size: 11px;
 }

.md h6, .usertext-edit textarea h6 {
 text-decoration: inherit!important;
}

I have a better one that allows for links and tables:

.md h6, .usertext-edit textarea h6 {
 display: block;
 padding: 0.3em;
 background: #4aabe7;
 border: 1px solid gray;
 font: bold 110%/140% "monospace","Segoe UI";
 color: white;
}
.side .md h6 + table {
 display: none;
 margin: -8px 0px 0px;
 width: 100%;
 
}
.side .md h6:hover + table,
.side .md h6 + table:hover {
 display: table;
}
